mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dormitory (building, floor, room_no, type, capacity, current_count, gender, head_id) VALUES (#{building}, #{floor}, #{roomNo}, #{type}, #{capacity}, #{currentCount}, #{gender}, #{headId})
mapper.select: SELECT dm.id, dm.dormitory_id as dormitoryId, dm.user_id as userId, u.username, u.real_name as realName, u.phone, u.avatar, dm.join_time as joinTime FROM dormitory_member dm INNER JOIN user u ON dm.user_id = u.user_id WHERE dm.dormitory_id = #{dormitoryId} ORDER BY dm.join_time
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dormitory_member WHERE dormitory_id = #{dormitoryId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE dormitory SET current_count = current_count + #{count} WHERE id = #{dormitoryId}
UPDATE dormitory SET head_id = #{headId} WHERE id = #{id}
